title: #082. Share-House Room & Fair Rent Division
subtitle: Assign rooms to maximize total roommate valuation first, then divide total rent envy-freely to maximize the minimum roommate surplus.

judge.m0: Output must be an object { assignment, rents, totalValuation, minSurplus }.
judge.m1: assignment[{p0}] must be an integer room index in [0, {p1}] (received {p2}).
judge.m2: Room {p0} is assigned to more than one roommate.
judge.m4: Sum of rents ({p0}) does not equal totalRent ({p1}).
judge.m5: Reported totalValuation ({p0}) does not match computed sum ({p1}).
judge.m6: Stage-1 totalValuation ({p0}) is below the maximum achievable valuation ({p1}).
judge.m7: Envy-freeness violated: roommate {p0} gets surplus {p2} in room {p1}, but would get {p4} in room {p3}.
judge.m8: Reported minSurplus ({p0}) does not match computed minimum surplus ({p1}).
judge.m9: Assignment is envy-free, but minSurplus ({p0}) is below the fair maximum ({p1}).
judge.m10: Envy-free assignment and fair rent division verified (minSurplus = {p0}).
